desc: Derive and prove the closed/open residual DP states and transitions, including how to detect valid one- and two-child combinations in linear time per vertex.
Establish the invariant that an open residual length is uniquely determined by the subtree size modulo \(K\), and handle residual lengths reaching or exceeding \(K\).
Develop an iterative postorder traversal suitable for up to \(2\times10^5\) vertices, avoiding recursion-depth issues.
Implement the algorithm in Python with overall \(O(NK)\) time and \(O(NK)\) memory.
Verify correctness on \(K=1\), \(N=1\), stars, chains, branching configurations, and both samples.
